text:
Dear Ms. Lee,

Thank you for [1] our store last week. We hope you enjoyed your shopping experience. [2] As a loyal customer, you are invited to our private sale, which starts on June 3. Please present this e-mail at the entrance to receive an additional 10 percent discount [3] your purchase. We look forward to seeing you [4].

Sincerely,
The Greenfield Team

questions.explanation: 'Thank you for' is followed by a gerund.

choices: The store will be closed on Sundays.
We value your opinion and your loyalty.
questions.explanation: The sentence must connect thanks for the visit with the invitation that follows.
'a discount on a purchase' is the standard collocation.
'Look forward to seeing you soon' is the natural closing.
